asset.name: MorphingIcon
asset.description: The icon-transition component animating between icon states with true path morphing where the geometry is compatible, and a configurable transform or crossfade fallback where it is not.

requires.reason: Every spacing, size, and radius value resolves to a declared ramp rather than a literal.
Motion policy is resolved through the shared hook so the preference can be overridden and tested.
Enter and exit lifecycle, interruption, and nesting are owned once rather than per animated component.
Both icon states resolve through the registry so geometry compatibility is knowable.

signatureMoment.description: A control's icon transforms into its new meaning in place, so the state change is read as the same object changing rather than two separate icons swapping.
